original_requirement: TODO37 Indexing progress reporting an agent can poll: persist per-phase progress (files done/total, phase, ETA) and expose via get_job_status.
delivered: get_job_status preserves status/message and appends structured phase, completed/total/unit, phase percent, observation timestamps and estimated phase time remaining.

Background index_project, changed/unchanged update_project and index_git_history forward/backfill/refresh emit durable observations for their actual source/history work and subsequent flush/graph/publication phases.
Optional phase observation lives in the existing JSON job row. Existing rows remain readable, terminal and restart transitions preserve it, and deleting a job removes its observation with the row.

Progress writes atomically check that the job still exists and is running; late callbacks cannot revive a cancelled/deleted job. Intermediate writes are throttled; phase changes and phase completion are observed immediately.
Phase100percent is explicitly distinct from job completion. Unknown phases/counts/ETA remain null, and terminal jobs expose their last observation without a live ETA.

observation.estimate_scope: Current phase at observation time only; not whole-job ETA. Later flush, graph, publication and enrichment work may have unknown duration. A phase at100% does not mean the job is complete.

normal_ociusx.interpretation: Read-only normal installed compatibility check on existing job metadata; no production indexing, source changes or new performance claim.

limitations: ETA is an estimate for the observed phase, based on completed work and elapsed time; it is not a whole-job completion forecast. Unknown-duration work and slow individual files/commits can make it stale; observation time remains explicit.
Percent/counters describe the current or last observed phase, not a weighted aggregate across phases. Terminal/cancelled states do not fabricate completed counts.

Other job types and historical rows without an observation report unavailable phase coverage. An older application can read the JSON row but does not emit/preserve the new observation on its own writes.

Scoped functional delivery only; no throughput, model-quality or comparative productivity gain is claimed. Original19gates, TODO36 performance acceptance, remaining original backlog and held work stay open.
CodeRabbit authentication unavailable in the retained review context; parent manual review only.
